description: Source code for the Kubernetes PodSecurity admission plugin, implementing admission control logic, version handling, and object conversion.

classes.name: Plugin
classes.description: Represents the PodSecurity admission plugin, managing configuration, version inspection, and validation logic.

classes.name: lazyConvertingAttributes
classes.description: Wraps admission.Attributes to lazily convert objects between internal and external versions.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers the PodSecurity plugin with the admission framework.

methods.name: newPlugin
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the PodSecurity admission plugin from configuration.

methods.name: SetExternalKubeInformerFactory
methods.description: Sets the informer factory for the plugin to access Kubernetes resources.

methods.name: SetExternalKubeClientSet
methods.description: Sets the Kubernetes client for the plugin.

methods.name: updateDelegate
methods.description: Updates the delegate admission object with current informers and client.

methods.name: InspectEffectiveVersion
methods.description: Inspects and records the effective Kubernetes version for policy evaluation.

methods.name: ValidateInitialization
methods.description: Validates that the plugin has been properly initialized.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Performs validation of admission requests against PodSecurity policies.

methods.name: GetObject
methods.description: Lazily converts and retrieves the object associated with the admission request.

methods.name: GetOldObject
methods.description: Lazily converts and retrieves the old object associated with the admission request.

methods.name: GetOperation
methods.description: Returns the operation type of the admission request.

methods.name: GetUserName
methods.description: Returns the username of the requester.
